calibration.scope:
Development-only grouped threshold/calibration diagnostics.

The base checkpoints used these validation groups for early stopping. Cross-fitting
calibration reduces threshold fitting optimism, but does not make these scores an
independent model test. This script never loads confirmation arrays or results.

next_study.scope:
Freeze four outer group folds within current training groups, without signals.

The current internal validation remains fixed for selection. Both consumed test
partitions are excluded. This is a development-population robustness study with
historical fitting exposure, not a newly acquired external confirmation cohort.
next_study.selection: Within each outer fold select neural and tree recipes by highest three-fit ensemble AUC on fixed internal validation; no outer selection.
next_study.threshold: Exact macro-F1 optimum on internal validation only.
next_study.unblinding: Fit all candidates/all folds, save selection and hashes, then evaluate outer groups. No outer-driven refitting or threshold tuning.
